title: Glowing popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='32' ry='40' fill='#3a1a5e' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='24' ry='32' fill='#5a2a8e' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Popsicle stick -->
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='12' height='22' rx='3' fill='#d4a056'/>
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#e8c07a'/>
  
  <!-- Popsicle body - main ice -->
  <rect x='30' y='18' width='40' height='58' rx='12' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  
  <!-- Lighter ice highlight (left side) -->
  <rect x='33' y='21' width='14' height='52' rx='8' fill='#ff7a94'/>
  
  <!-- Drip on right side -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='62' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='60' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff7a94'/>
  
  <!-- Drip on left -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='58' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='56' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ff7a94'/>
  
  <!-- Frost/ice shine top arc -->
  <path d='M38 22 Q50 16 62 22' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle dots on the ice -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Glow highlight bottom of popsicle -->
  <rect x='34' y='64' width='32' height='9' rx='6' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Cute face on popsicle -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3a1a5e'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3a1a5e'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 54 56 48' fill='none' stroke='#3a1a5e' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9eb5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9eb5' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Glow lines radiating -->
  <line x1='18' y1='30' x2='23' y2='33' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='15' y1='45' x2='21' y2='45' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='60' x2='23' y2='57' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='77' y1='30' x2='82' y2='33' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='79' y1='45' x2='85' y2='45' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='77' y1='60' x2='82' y2='57' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
